new_declaration:
@[deprecated LinearIsometry.isComplete_image_iff (since := "2025-12-25")]
theorem isComplete_image_iff' (f : LinearIsometry σ₁₂ E E₂) {s : Set E} :
    IsComplete (f '' s) ↔ IsComplete s :=
  LinearIsometry.isComplete_image_iff _

example (g : E →ₛₗᵢ[σ₁₂] E₂) {s : Set E} : IsComplete (g '' s) ↔ IsComplete s := by
  simp only [LinearIsometry.isComplete_image_iff]

example (g : E →ₛₗᵢ[σ₁₂] E₂) {s : Set E} (hs : IsComplete s) : IsComplete (g '' s) := by
  simpa using hs

example (g : E →ₛₗᵢ[σ₁₂] E₂) (x : E) : ‖g x‖₊ = ‖x‖₊ := by
  simp only [SemilinearIsometryClass.nnnorm_map]
